title: The Supply filter still uses the positive bins for a part with a negative bin
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-SUPPLY-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with Min 4 and Max 10, 5 in {Bin-A} and -2 in {Bin-B}.
  • On its positive bins (5) {Part-A} sits between Min and Max; on the net figure (3) it would be below Min.
  • Line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET SUPPLY") of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) took 2 of {Part-A} from {Bin-B} while {Bin-B} held 0, which put {Bin-B} at -2.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A}.
  2. Open the Supply filter and choose Under-supplied.
  3. Read the list.
  4. Change the Supply filter to Well-supplied.
  5. Read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-A} is not listed under Under-supplied: the net 3 is not used by the Supply filter.
  • Step 5: {Part-A} is listed under Well-supplied (5 on the positive bins lies between Min 4 and Max 10), as before this fix.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026 and unchanged on 14 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), §2 Accounting, read 14 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

  • SV-10380 code evidence: “positive-only availability is also used for operational supply filtering; preserve that behavior.”
